versicle: You are alone with the dark now. Nothing is asked of you.
phenomena: Melatonin saturates the brain: deepest phase of slow-wave neurological repair
Mushrooms release their spores
Plants grow best in the shade of night

versicle: Something shifts in the silence. The darkness is unchanged, but its edges loosen.
phenomena: Metabolic nadir: blood cools and breathing slows
Worms retreat underground
Atmospheric stasis; dew point

versicle: The sound comes before the light. The world remembers it exists.
phenomena: Songbirds begin the dawn chorus
Insects and other cold-blooded creatures shake off their nocturnal chill
Stomata open to inhale the morning carbon: photosynthesis initiates

versicle: The day lifts. Light is now something you move through rather than look at.
phenomena: Synchronized migration of human workforces: scattered commuter densities
Sap ascends
Convective heating triggers the first rising columns of air

versicle: Your shadow is directly beneath you. For a moment, there is no pointing away.
phenomena: Solar zenith achieved: zero azimuth deviation, maximum ultraviolet index
Petals unfurl to maximum aperture
Lunch hour

versicle: The angle of the light has become philosophical. Every object casts a shadow longer than itself.
phenomena: Shadows elongate, red-shift in light
The afternoon lull: synchronized quietude of birds and bugs
Neurocognitive deceleration; prefrontal executive control fractures under cumulative mental load

versicle: The light lingers above. The lamps offer their devotion.
phenomena: Shared caloric replenishment; social structures visible
Crepuscular swarming and/or dispersal
Gradual descent into passive respiration, circadian quiescence

versicle: The day closes; the night opens. Something may be laid down now.
phenomena: Nocturnal activities commence
Plants complete their nyctinastic closing
Peak marine bioluminescence
